verdict.rationale: Eqvista's round modeling tool shows cap table dilution from new investments and accounts for a new option pool. It takes pre-money/post-money valuation and investment amount inputs, and exports a downloadable PDF meant for sharing with stakeholders. A community user independently praised the round modeling feature. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE conversion within round modeling (docs only show adding SAFEs to the cap table and converting notes via a spreadsheet method), and scenario sharing beyond a static PDF export (e.g., a live, permissioned shared scenario for counsel and investors).
